arrival_intervention.factor: Synchronized periodic intensity modulation; unchanged total arrivals, average load and task identities
arrival_intervention.base_tape: Existing poisson_arrivals with original catalogue/load rates and new200001..200012 seeds
arrival_intervention.phase_coupling: Independent phase stream, same high/low-first bit for all classes and cells within each seed
arrival_intervention.transformation: Inverse cumulative intensity multiplier applied to the same steady tape; no new birth draws and no task deletion
arrival_intervention.matched_exposure: Integrated clock equals identity at300/900/1200; same counts per class, same cohort job IDs and class FIFO identities
arrival_intervention.rationale: Equal50-second segments yield a3:1 rate contrast while preserving average load.100-second period exactly divides all registered evaluation endpoints, isolating temporal clustering from cohort-population changes. These fixed levels were chosen before any new outcome.

frozen_algorithms.rate_estimator: Causally released cumulative births / now; zero exposure gives zero rates
frozen_algorithms.information: Original catalogue, queues, FIFO ages, loaded commitments, now/lane and released counts only; true rates, phase, period, future literal tape and stop time remain in the harness
frozen_algorithms.clock: Unchanged asynchronous physical service clock and1-second idle polls; computation separately charged
frozen_algorithms.changes: None to BG/MW/no-background/S1-only policies, service catalogue, queue envelope, S2 threshold, overflow or tie rules

execution.placement: OneCPU1/BLAS1 task per independent trajectory on node001-node006, livephysical-core planning; registeredunit0 validates integration, remaining767 submitted together without duplicating unit0
execution.validation: Same frozen feasible-support/FIFO engine and actual literal-birth checks; existing full causal/risk/budget checks for each rollout policy. No independently rerun MW-shadow claim
execution.data_motion: Literal fixtures, full trajectories and full server summary remain on server; local receipts/logs/compact statistics only

outcomes.primary: BG minus MW within each profile:1200 cohort restrictedmean and equal-tape same-pair common-completed-ID P90;900/1200 unfinished counts
outcomes.profile_interaction: Bursty policy contrast minus matched steady policy contrast; mean/P90 equal-tape differences and unfinished total-count differences
outcomes.populations: Compute shared completed IDs separately for every profile/policy pair. Cross-profile P90 interaction compares defined profile contrasts, not individual job causal effects
outcomes.preserve: All8 cells,12 seed blocks,24 class groups and individual tape signs; queued/inflight/unfinished tails and actual work
outcomes.performance_screen: Original1% mean gain, loadmean nonregression,5% per-group P90/unfinished tolerance and pooledtail nonincrease, separately perprofile; no newautomaticadoption

bootstrap.unit: 12 whole new actual-arrival seed blocks, bothprofiles,all8cells and allpolicycontrasts retained together
bootstrap.interval: Pointwise percentile95%; ratios of resampled equal-tape means; unfinished count differences only

statistics: Pre-execution frozen new-seed matched-profile performance experiment.12 paired seed blocks conditional on fixed planning streams; pointwise intervals without multiplicity adjustment.192 tapes are not independent samples. No policy tuning or replacement of original BG confirmation.
limitations: Tests synchronized periodic nonhomogeneous-Poisson intensity only, not irregular heavy-tailed bursts or full-period count overdispersion. Services remain deterministic measured catalogue models; compute delays excluded. Original homogeneous-Poisson stability proof and sampled S2 do not imply a P90 or deployment guarantee here.
